item.title: Butter Chicken
item.description: Ingredients Chicken [1 cup (240 g)] full-fat yogurt [1 Tbsp (15 g)] garam masala [1 Tbsp (15 g)] kosher salt [1 1/2 lbs (680 g)] boneless, skinless chicken thighs Butter Chicken Curry [2 Tbsp (30 g)] vegetable oil [1] yellow onion, diced 2-inch knob of ginger, finely diced [6] cloves of sliced garlic Salt and pepper to taste [2 tsp (8 g)] paprika [2 tsp (9 g)] ground cumin [1 Tbsp (14 g)] garam masala [1 1/2 tsp (6 g)] turmeric powder (optional) [14 oz] crushed tomatoes [2/3 cup (160 ml)] water [1 cup (240 ml)] heavy cream [2 Tbsp (28 g)] unsalted butter Steamed rice Fresh cilantro Instructions In a medium bowl, whisk together [1 cup (240 g)] full-fat yogurt, [1 Tbsp (15 g)] garam masala, and [1 Tbsp (15 g)] kosher salt.

item.title: Greek Couscous and Lentil Salad
item.description: Ingredients Green lentils Couscous Cherry tomatoes Cucumbers [1 1/2 tsp] salt [1] shallot Vinegar Olives Fresh herbs (e.g., dill, basil, parsley) Feta cheese Olive oil Black pepper to taste Instructions In a pot of salted water, add the green lentils and bring to a boil. Set a timer for 10 minutes. After 10 minutes, add the couscous to the pot and continue cooking for an additional 10-12 minutes. Meanwhile, halve the cherry tomatoes (through the belly, not the stem) and place them over a strainer set over a bowl.
